subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require live 2026.6.11 reproduction before any cap or Skill Workshop persistence fix is attempted for this issue?
rationale: Current source and release-tag inspection contradict the claimed 600-700 core caps, while changing cap policy or workshop lookup behavior without the exact failing surface could regress valid output bounding and proposal scoping.

options.title: Require live reproduction first
options.body: Keep this issue open with needs-info/manual-review until a packaged Linux gateway run captures raw transcript/config/proposal evidence for the exact failing path.

options.title: Split read-output overlap
options.body: Treat the read-only truncation portion as overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84659 while preserving this issue for Skill Workshop and non-read tool evidence.

options.title: Sponsor cap-policy work now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly choose to align display/progress caps with toolResultMaxChars before full reproduction, accepting compatibility risk around larger visible tool output.

recommendation.title: Require live reproduction first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with needs-info/manual-review until a packaged Linux gateway run captures raw transcript/config/proposal evidence for the exact failing path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent history across the read, tool-result, visible delivery, and harness-runtime surfaces implicated by the report.
